snippet.title: Obey the Insect God Game Reveal Trailer - English
snippet.description:
Obey the Insect God

Step foot into the lair of the Insect God...if you dare. Face brutal enemies in pulse-pounding combat with digitized sprites that harken back to your favorite controversial fighting game from the ’90s that your mom’s hairdresser’s kid let you play that one time. The castle awaits…

Coming to PC and Steamdeck!

Wishlist Now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4109630/Obey_the_Insect_God/
